purpose: Fixed post-RoPE Hadamard control and one-shot untouched official-test check, requested after two-seed validation findings.
checkpoints: Existing final step61036, 500006912 tokens each; no training or weight update.

method_sources.rope_hadamard: same-seed RoPE plus fixed post-position transform
method_sources.spectral_rope: same-seed Vortex Q/K weights transformed by original spectral.convert_checkpoint

hadamard.definition: H[i,j]=(-1)^popcount(i & j)/sqrt(128); natural Sylvester order, no sign randomization or fitting
hadamard.placement: On each head Q and K after their RoPE position transform and before quantization; same H across Q/K, heads, layers, tokens and seeds. V unchanged.
hadamard.arithmetic: Seven FP32 butterfly add/sub stages then multiply by 1/sqrt(128) and cast to input dtype; no autocast matmul.

bf16_reporting: Corresponding full-split BF16 NLL for every seed/method, with separately reported quantization increment.

quantization.scale: Per-token per-head max(abs(x))/7, FP32, one scale per 128 values; clamp_min(1e-12) before /7.
quantization.implementation: Unchanged src.quant.quantize through src.ring_quant, same post-position configuration for all four methods.
quantization.rounding: torch.round then clamp, dequantize and cast back; attention BF16/FP32, no native INT4 claim

evaluation.precision: BF16 autocast; FP32 model weights; FP32 cross-entropy; FP64 aggregation
evaluation.coverage: All next-token targets; contiguous original order, nonoverlapping causal rows, final short row retained; no sliding window or split mixing.
evaluation.no_selection: Exactly two existing seeds and four fixed methods, both conditions; no test-time tuning, extra transforms, chosen checkpoints or seed selection.

correctness.gate: All six FP32 whole-model cases must pass before INT4 evaluation; independent dense-reference butterfly error <2e-6 and matrix orthogonality error <1e-12.
correctness.bf16: Record whole-model drift on the same six cases plus full BF16 NLL; bitwise equality not required.

official_test.metadata_source: Pinned-revision Hugging Face file metadata, checked before test download; no test text or metrics read.
official_test.tokenizer: Reuse unchanged train-only fitted tokenizer; no test fitting.
official_test.packing: Identical to original train/validation: preserve rows/newlines, EOS before top-level article heading and split end.

analysis.report: Every seed/method value; equal-seed mean NLL, BF16 NLL and INT4 increment; PPL only as exp(NLL).
analysis.uncertainty: Optional paired 8192-token contiguous-block bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20261111; text sampling only, never training-seed inference.
analysis.catch_up: Describe per-seed and mean final NLL differences between fixed Hadamard and Vortex; no post-hoc equivalence margin or universal claim.

sequence: Freeze plan and evaluation source, commit and push publicly before any test evaluation
One-shot full test, all 16 seed/method/precision cells
Report all values and push results
